To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the genetic diversity of maize genotypes was high and could be exploited by selection.
the genetic diversity among the maize genotypes studied was high and the genetic variability was high under drought conditions, and that the genetic variability under normal conditions was low.
the genetic variability in drought tolerance in maize is controlled by additive genetic factors and that selection should lead fast genetic improvement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of genotypes with drought tolerance and the determination of the genetic variability for drought tolerance in the maize crop.
the identification of genotypes with superior drought tolerance traits.
the identification of drought tolerant genotypes in maize and the evaluation of the most important characters responsible for variation among these genotypes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the traits studied in this study are under the control of both additive and non-additive genetic effects and are highly heritable.
the genotypes evaluated were highly diverse and could be used for further improvement of the maize crop under both normal and drought stress conditions.
the genetic diversity in the genotypes of maize is very high and that the characters studied are under the control of polygenic effects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the genetic variability for the traits studied was high and the traits were under the control additive genetic effects.
the genetic diversity in maize is very rich and that the selection of genotypes with desirable agronomic traits is possible.
the drought tolerant genotypes could be identified by using the cluster analysis and the principle component analysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have identified a set of 13 traits that are important in determining the drought tolerance of maize genotypes.
the drought tolerance of the maize crop is a quantitative character, and it can be improved through the use of selection methods.
drought tolerance can be improved by selecting for the traits that are associated with drought resistance and that are under the control of major genes.
